description: This file declares the interface for an alternator controller module, including function prototypes for initialization, parameter setting, information display, and configuration change handling.

methods.name: initAlternatorCtrl
methods.description: Initializes the alternator controller with shared logger instance.

methods.name: setAltPFactor
methods.description: Sets the proportional factor for the alternator controller.

methods.name: setAltIFactor
methods.description: Sets the integral factor for the alternator controller.

methods.name: setAltDFactor
methods.description: Sets the derivative factor for the alternator controller.

methods.name: showAltInfo
methods.description: Displays information about the alternator status.

methods.name: setDefaultAlternatorParameters
methods.description: Resets alternator parameters to default values.

methods.name: onConfigurationChangeAlternatorCallback
methods.description: Handles configuration change events for the alternator.
